token = resp['access_token']
artist_id = 3  # Jasper Skye from search_artists

page_limit = 20
all_songs = []
i = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.search_songs(
        query='',
        artist_id=artist_id,
        sort_by='-play_count',
        page_index=i,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    print('page', i, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_songs.extend(page)
    i += 1
print('total songs found:', len(all_songs))
# compute max play_count
max_play = max(s['play_count'] for s in all_songs) if all_songs else None
print('max_play', max_play)
top_titles = sorted({s['title'] for s in all_songs if s['play_count']==max_play})
print('top_titles', top_titles)
